svg.title: When could the extra checks pay back?
svg.desc: Assuming the saved success rates recur and the same recovery cost per failure, Compound breaks even above 31.5 cents of later recovery per avoided failed refactor with Opus, or 10.6 cents with Sonnet. Small sample: six attempts per mode and model. This is not measured long-term savings.
